<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"List a site's zones"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/sites/{siteCode}/zones"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every Zone in the given Site, ordered by zone id. Answers 404 if the site itself is unknown, rather than an empty list, so a caller can tell "no zones yet" apart from "no such site". Keyset-paginated: `limit` and `cursor`; follow `nextCursor` until it is absent.
